'''Parting the Silk''' is a [[sword form]].

==Description==
Parting the Silk is a form often used at the beginning of battle. It is also used to practice balance.

==In practice==
[[Lan Mandragoran]] told [[Rand al'Thor]] to use this form to train his balance.{{ref/book|2|1}} Later, when chasing after [[Padan Fain]] and the [[Horn of Valere]], Rand practices with this form.{{ref/book|2|15}} During the duel between Rand and [[The Blood|High Lord]] [[Turak Aladon]], one of them uses Parting the Silk while the opposing side countered with [[The Swallow Takes Flight]].{{ref/book|2|45}} In the battle in the sky over [[Falme]], Rand initiates with Parting the Silk against [[Ishamael|Ba'alzamon]], "but Ba'alzamon beat every cut aside."{{ref/book|2|47}} Rand also used this form against [[Be'lal]] in the [[Stone of Tear]].{{ref/book|3|55}} While training in [[Caemlyn]], one of Rand's sparring partners tried to use Parting the Silk, however Rand broke through with [[The Boar Rushes Down the Mountain]].{{ref/book|6|1}} After side-stepping and moving into [[Eamon Valda]]'s initial attack, [[Galadedrid Damodred]] used this form as his first strike. Valda took a gash down his right forearm as a result.{{ref/book|11|p}} After unsheathing his sword, [[Gawyn Trakand]] used Parting the Silk non-leathally against [[Gareth Bryne]]'s soldiers when he tried to gain access to the war camp.{{ref/book|12|24}}
